title: One listener on the parent

blocks.md:
## Delegation

One listener on `ul#list` can handle clicks on any `button` inside, including buttons you add later. Check `event.target.matches("button")`.

blocks.promptMd: A parent listener (bubble) hears clicks on a button appended after bind?

choices.md: No — you had to bind that button
Yes — the click bubbles to the parent

blocks.promptMd: > Clicking a button in `#list` should set `#picked` to that button’s `data-name`.

description: One listener on a parent can handle many children.
